# nomatron_users (Data Source)

Fetch a single user by username, or all users when username is omitted.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nomatron_users" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `username` (String) If set, fetch a single user by username. If omitted, fetch all users.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable Terraform state ID.
- `user` (Attributes) Single user result when username is provided. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--user))
- `users` (Attributes List) List of users when username is omitted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--user"></a>
### Nested Schema for `user`

Read-Only:

- `auth_provider` (String) Authentication provider for the user.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the user was created.
- `created_by` (String) Actor that created the user.
- `id` (String) The user ID.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the user is active.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Metadata attached to the user.
- `name` (String) Display name for the user.
- `username` (String) The username for the user.

- `auth_provider` (String) Authentication provider for the user.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the user was created.

- `name` (String) Display name for the user.
